about: Shared golden cases for name scrubbing before text goes to Claude. The same file is meant to sit in the engine (health-check) and the console (blackcloud-next). Build a Pseudonymiser by labelling each of people in order with label(kind, id, name, aliases), then for each case: guardPrompt(text) must equal guarded exactly; findNames(guarded) must be empty; findNames(text) must be non-empty exactly when flaggedBefore is true; and restore(guarded) on that same pseudonymiser must equal restored. Shared-name tokens are labelled in key order the first time a guard runs, which is why each case starts from a fresh pseudonymiser. Synthetic people only: ids zero-padded, emails at example.com.

cases.name: a first name on its own
cases.text: Anna said the forecast is a guess.
cases.guarded: [[user:U0006]] said the forecast is a guess.
cases.restored: Anna van der Berg said the forecast is a guess.

cases.name: a first name two people share gets its own token
cases.text: Sam said the forecast is a guess.
cases.guarded: [[user:U0012]] said the forecast is a guess.
cases.restored: Sam said the forecast is a guess.

cases.name: a full name still gets its owner's token
cases.text: Sam Reed and Sam Patel both said so.
cases.restored: Sam Reed and Sam Patel both said so.

cases.name: a possessive keeps its 's
cases.text: Patel's pipeline is thin.
cases.restored: Sam Patel's pipeline is thin.

cases.name: a curly possessive
cases.text: Patel’s pipeline is thin.
cases.restored: Sam Patel’s pipeline is thin.

cases.name: lower case and capitals at the start of a sentence
cases.text: patel thinks so. PATEL agrees. Patel signed.
cases.restored: Sam Patel thinks so. Sam Patel agrees. Sam Patel signed.

cases.name: a surname on its own
cases.text: Reed owns the renewal.
cases.restored: Sam Reed owns the renewal.

cases.name: a hyphenated first name, whole and in parts
cases.text: Mary-Jane approved it; Jane disagreed; Mary was out.
cases.restored: Mary-Jane O'Brien approved it; Mary-Jane O'Brien disagreed; Mary-Jane O'Brien was out.

cases.name: an apostrophe surname, with and without the apostrophe
cases.text: O'Brien, OBrien and O’Brien's team.
cases.restored: Mary-Jane O'Brien, Mary-Jane O'Brien and Mary-Jane O'Brien's team.

cases.name: accents written or left off
cases.text: Jose Garcia, garcía and GARCÍA.
cases.restored: José García, José García and José García.

cases.name: an accented first name and a hyphenated surname's parts
cases.text: Zoe, Lindqvist and Ahn met Lindqvist-Ahn.
cases.restored: Zoë Lindqvist-Ahn, Zoë Lindqvist-Ahn and Zoë Lindqvist-Ahn met Zoë Lindqvist-Ahn.

cases.name: a surname with particles is masked as a run, and a lone particle is left
cases.text: Anna van der Berg said van der Berg would hire a van.
cases.restored: Anna van der Berg said Anna van der Berg would hire a van.

cases.name: a common-word name is masked only with a capital
cases.text: Will said you will review it.
cases.restored: Will Price said you will review it.

cases.name: a full name is matched in any case, even where it reads as words
cases.text: Then you will price it.
cases.restored: Then you Will Price it.

cases.name: a common-word surname is masked with a capital, even in a product name
cases.text: Price agreed, but the price book and Price Book need work.
cases.guarded: [[user:U0005]] agreed, but the price book and [[user:U0005]] Book need work.
cases.restored: Will Price agreed, but the price book and Will Price Book need work.

cases.name: a month that is also a surname is over-scrubbed
cases.text: Rose May said the rose report is due in May.
cases.guarded: [[user:U0008]] said the rose report is due in [[user:U0008]].
cases.restored: Rose May said the rose report is due in Rose May.

cases.name: a common word inside a hyphenated word is left
cases.text: Cross-sell is up, and Cross said so.
cases.guarded: Cross-sell is up, and [[user:U0007]] said so.
cases.restored: Cross-sell is up, and Ben Cross said so.

cases.name: an uncommon name inside a hyphenated word is masked
cases.text: Reed-approved discounts and Patel-led deals.
cases.restored: Sam Reed-approved discounts and Sam Patel-led deals.

cases.name: a formal name beats a nickname
cases.text: Samuel said the call went well.
cases.restored: Samuel Okafor said the call went well.

cases.name: a nickname of a formal first name
cases.text: Sammy said the call went well.
cases.restored: Samuel Okafor said the call went well.

cases.name: a mailbox name that isn't part of the name
cases.text: spatel and sokafor replied.
cases.restored: Sam Patel and Samuel Okafor replied.

cases.name: names inside an API name
cases.text: Sam_Reed_Approval and Acme_Lead_Routing.
cases.restored: Sam Reed_Approval and Acme Holdings_Lead_Routing.

cases.name: an invisible character inside a name
cases.text: S​am Re​ed called.
cases.restored: Sam Reed called.

cases.name: full-width letters
cases.text: Ｒｅｅｄ called.
cases.restored: Sam Reed called.

cases.name: a name in quotes
cases.text: 'Reed' said 'no'.
cases.restored: 'Sam Reed' said 'no'.

cases.name: a company name needs a capital
cases.text: Acme said acme pricing is fine.
cases.restored: Acme Holdings said acme pricing is fine.

cases.name: any email address, known or not
cases.text: Write to someone@elsewhere.example or spatel@example.com.
cases.restored: Write to [[email]] or Sam Patel.

cases.name: a record id
cases.restored: Owner Sam Reed.

cases.name: ordinary words that share a name part survive
cases.text: Sales Cloud integration, the Default Workflow User and a will to close.
cases.guarded: Sales Cloud integration, the Default Workflow User and a will to close.
cases.restored: Sales Cloud integration, the Default Workflow User and a will to close.

cases.name: existing tokens are left alone
cases.text: [[user:U0001]] and [[user:U0002]] own it.
cases.restored: Sam Reed and Sam Patel own it.
